rationale: A 37-year-old woman returning to France from West Africa in 2004 was diagnosed with concurrent Plasmodium falciparum malaria and Dengue virus serotype 3 infection. Zika is never mentioned in the article; retrieval was triggered by 'flavivirus RNA' and 'flavivirus consensus primers', which amplified a 163-bp product confirmed by BLAST and phylogenetic analysis as Dengue virus serotype 3 (GenBank AY862501) -> EXCLUDED_NON_TARGET_CASE.
